title: Photographs of Ed Lansdale in Dealey Plaza identified by his wife

tellings.quote: Photographs of Lansdale sitting right there and his wife identifying it.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that there are photographs of Ed Lansdale, a US military intelligence officer, sitting in Dealey Plaza in Dallas, where President John F. Kennedy was shot in 1963. Sheehan says Lansdale's wife looked at the photos and said it was him. If so, it would put a secret-operations man at the scene of the killing.
